name: binding_access_range_at
reason: The proposition gives the binding_access_range answer when world >= require_world and the WorldWithRange ErrorException otherwise (Compiler/src/inferencestate.jl:262-265).

name: binding_changed_since_require_world
reason: The proposition restates the two branches with binding_access_range left as an unconstrained oracle, so it never states the comment's promise that the fast path gives the same answer as the walk; a fast path that disagrees with the walk satisfies it.

name: insert_backedges
reason: VerifyMethodSound runs verifyMethod directly on a fresh workspace (runVerify), so insertBackedges, with its scan_new_methods! call and workspace setup, is never unfolded; the bug yaml shows the effect through it, but the Lean entry does not.

name: scan_new_code!
reason: stale-min-world never calls scanNewCode (so the lookup reset on a world change and the promote call are not in it), and promote-ci-noop is about the C jl_promote_ci_to_current and only states its no-op when the world moved.

name: verify_method_graph
reason: runVerify calls verifyMethod directly, so verifyMethodGraph's workspace and child_cycle == 0 assertions are not in any proposition.

name: needs_instrumentation
reason: Only the two early returns are stated, and the coverage and malloc-log branch, the method's purpose, is unmodelled, so `fun _ => false` satisfies the proposition.

name: verify_method
reason: The stale-min-world refutation unfolds the state machine and holds on a heap that keeps RuntimeConsistent (reproduced with a real threaded package load), but the row's cycle-group and range-bounded entries are still todo; settle them or take them off the row.

name: get_method_from_edge
reason: The proposition gives the exact method for Method, MethodInstance and CodeInstance edges and the TypeError for every other edge.

name: get_mi_from_edge
reason: The proposition gives nothing for a Method, the exact instance for MethodInstance and CodeInstance edges, and the TypeError otherwise.

name: expected_dominates_sig
reason: The iff says LATEST_ONLY on mi or isempty(meth.interferences), with isempty read as allocated length 0 as on Memory.

name: method_in_expecteds
reason: The iff gives membership by uid, which is `===` on methods.

name: eachinterference
reason: The proposition says the result is exactly the takeWhile of the mapped assigned entries with primary_world <= cutoff.

name: Base.iterate
reason: The iterate steps (stop at the end, at an unassigned slot or past the cutoff) fold into eachinterference's loop over the assigned prefix, which the proposition pins exactly.

name: method_in_interferences
reason: The proposition gives the exact membership answer, under a hypothesis that only says the set's methods exist and have UInt primary worlds.

name: method_morespecific_recorded
reason: Only irreflexivity and asymmetry are stated, so a function that always returns false satisfies it; nothing ties it to membership in the two interference sets.

name: method_is_latest_which
reason: The iff says bit 0x1 of dispatch_status is set.

name: method_in_image_deps
reason: The proposition gives false for no image and for a method of no image, and the exact linkage_blob_dep_world test otherwise.

name: sig_contributors_world
reason: The proposition gives 0 for no image and the exact C answer otherwise (debug log off, as everywhere in the model).

name: promote_mi_to_current
reason: The proposition is "nothing changes, or under these conditions the status becomes LATEST_ONLY", so a no-op satisfies it; nothing says the promotion happens when its conditions hold.

name: newmethod_removed_silently
reason: It only says a true result implies the body's own guards held, so always-false satisfies it, and the comment's promise (acceptance implies ml_matches returns exactly the expected methods with no ambiguity) is not stated.

name: expected_is_minmax
reason: Only the true-implies-guards direction is stated, which restates the body; always-false satisfies it, and the minmax property its comment argues is not stated.

name: has_empty_set_cover
reason: Only "true implies some expected method meets the loop's own test" is stated, so always-false satisfies it, and the converse (it finds such a cover when one exists) is not stated.

name: morespecific_cannot_cycle
reason: Only the true direction of the loop's own test is stated, so always-false satisfies it.

name: verify_call_lookup
reason: The result is pinned to a memo entry whose range contains world (same lim) or to the _methods_by_ftype answer, stored when memoizing; a version that never reuses the memo gives the same results, and exactness across the range rests on the stated C promise.

name: verify_call
reason: verifyMethod calls verifyCall step by step, the refuted soundness statement sits on its interference cutoff at world = codeinst.min_world, and the repro shows stale code after a real `-t 2` package load in which another thread defines a method during the load.

name: verify_invokesig
reason: Only "acceptance implies one of the body's three accepting branches" is stated, so a verifier that always rejects satisfies it, and nothing says it accepts an invoke whose target is unchanged.
